record.original_question: For a smooth compactly supported map f: R^n -> R^n, let Df(x) be its Jacobian matrix and let J(x,f) be det Df(x). Determine the best constant lambda_p(n) in the integral Hadamard inequality, equivalently the smallest lambda such that the integral of |Df(x)|^(p-n) J(x,f) over R^n is bounded in absolute value by lambda times the integral of |Df(x)|^p over R^n for all such f.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ and $p\ge n$. For a smooth, compactly supported map $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^n$, let $Df(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ denote its Jacobian matrix at $x$, let $|Df(x)|$ denote the Hilbert–Schmidt (Frobenius) norm of $Df(x)$, and let $J(x,f)=\det Df(x)$. The pointwise Hadamard inequality $n^{n/2}|J(x,f)|\le |Df(x)|^n$ implies, after multiplying by $|Df(x)|^{p-n}$ and integrating, that
$$\left|\int_{\mathbb{R}^n} |Df(x)|^{p-n}\, J(x,f)\, dx\right| \le \lambda \int_{\mathbb{R}^n} |Df(x)|^p\, dx$$
for some constant $\lambda$. Determine the best (smallest) constant $\lambda_p(n)$ for which this inequality holds for every smooth compactly supported $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^n$.
artifact.category_tag: Sharp constants in Jacobian integral inequalities
artifact.status_search_result: The sharp value of the constant in this integral Hadamard inequality for Jacobians is a long-standing open question associated with work of T. Iwaniec and collaborators. Recent literature on "Hadamard's inequality in the mean" (e.g., 2023–2024 work) studies closely related sharpness questions and indicates that the cancellation phenomenon producing the gap with the pointwise Hadamard bound is still not fully understood; no general formula for $\lambda_p(n)$ appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Hadamard's inequality in the mean
status_evidence.snippet: Studies integral inequalities of the form ∫|∇φ|^n + f(x) det∇φ ≥ 0, showing strict improvement over pointwise Hadamard is possible, with sharp thresholds in special cases.
status_evidence.claim: The sharp constant in integral inequalities mixing |Df|^p and det Df remains an active research topic with only partial sharp results.

status_evidence.title: Hadamard's inequality in the mean (J. Nonlinear Analysis)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent paper investigating Hadamard-in-the-mean inequalities and sharp variation thresholds for piecewise constant weights.
status_evidence.claim: Related sharp-constant problem for integral Hadamard-type inequalities is studied with only partial results.
